theorems.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (P : Matrix ι κ R) (d : ℕ), (Ideal.span {x : R | ∃ (rows : Fin (d + 1) ↪ ι) (cols : Fin (d + 1) ↪ κ), x = Matrix.det (P.submatrix rows cols)}) ≤ Ideal.span {x : R | ∃ (rows : Fin d ↪ ι) (cols : Fin d ↪ κ), x = Matrix.det (P.submatrix rows cols)}
